The U.S., Mexico, and Canada should create a critical minerals club that would harmonize tariffs on imports of critical minerals from China, develop joint procurement to secure demand, and enable the three countries to create price certainty through [...] A USMCA club could create a slate of harmonized critical minerals tariffs as the basis of a broader agreement.
